//: Workspace type-safety contract + CROSS-PROJECT module aliases only. Deliberately has no `include`/`files`: every project supplies its own, so adding a NestJS file anywhere can never be swallowed into the Next.js program (the failure mode of the pre-migration root tsconfig). Module/target/lib/jsx are per-project — Next needs esnext+bundler+preserve, Nest needs commonjs+node. App-LOCAL aliases such as `@/*` are deliberately NOT here: a single shared `@/*` can only point at one app, so a dashboard import would silently resolve into storefront source. Each app declares its own.
